description: This PHP source file defines the HandlerList class used in the AWS SDK for PHP. It manages middleware functions and handlers for processing AWS commands, including middleware registration, ordering, and execution flow control based on different processing steps.

classes.name: HandlerList
classes.description: Manages a list of middleware handlers for AWS SDK requests, supporting middleware registration, ordering, and execution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HandlerList with an optional HTTP handler.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the middleware list and handler.

methods.name: setHandler
methods.description: Sets the main HTTP handler that returns a response.

methods.name: hasHandler
methods.description: Checks if a handler has been set.

methods.name: appendInit
methods.description: Adds middleware to the init step at the end.

methods.name: prependInit
methods.description: Adds middleware to the init step at the beginning.

methods.name: appendValidate
methods.description: Adds middleware to the validate step at the end.

methods.name: prependValidate
methods.description: Adds middleware to the validate step at the beginning.

methods.name: appendBuild
methods.description: Adds middleware to the build step at the end.

methods.name: prependBuild
methods.description: Adds middleware to the build step at the beginning.

methods.name: appendSign
methods.description: Adds middleware to the sign step at the end.

methods.name: prependSign
methods.description: Adds middleware to the sign step at the beginning.

methods.name: appendAttempt
methods.description: Adds middleware to the attempt step at the end.

methods.name: prependAttempt
methods.description: Adds middleware to the attempt step at the beginning.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Inserts middleware before a specified middleware by name.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Inserts middleware after a specified middleware by name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes middleware by name or instance.

methods.name: interpose
methods.description: Sets or removes a function to interpose between middleware layers for tracing or modification.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Builds and returns the composed handler function with all middleware applied.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of middleware functions across all steps.

methods.name: splice
methods.description: Inserts middleware before or after a specified middleware by name.

methods.name: debugCallable
methods.description: Generates a string description of a callable for debugging.

methods.name: sortMiddleware
methods.description: Sorts middleware functions and interposes if needed.

methods.name: removeByName
methods.description: Removes middleware by name.

methods.name: removeByInstance
methods.description: Removes middleware by function instance.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds middleware to a specific step, optionally at the beginning.
